en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a riverside town on the Elbe, with a long paddle steamer labeled "PILLNITZ" on the water in the foreground. Behind the quayside stand several ornate multi‑story buildings, including a large church with a tall spire and smaller towers, and a prominent hotel-like building with the words "Dampfschiff-Hotel" on the façade. The overall style is late 19th to early 20th century Central European.
